title: Red Flag Warning Continued: Sawmill County Foothills

fields.affected: ...EXERCISE... Fire weather zone 216, Sawmill County foothills, including Pine Gulch, Kestrel Springs and the County Road 68 (Gulch Road) corridor. ...EXERCISE...
fields.winds: West 30 mph with gusts up to 58 mph. Strongest gusts expected 9 AM to 4 PM along the foothills and canyon mouths.
fields.impacts: Any fire that develops will spread rapidly. Outdoor burning is not recommended.
actions: ...EXERCISE... EXERCISE MESSAGE ONLY. TEST. NOT A LIVE ALERT. ...EXERCISE...

A Red Flag Warning means critical fire weather conditions are occurring now or will begin shortly. Strong downslope winds, very low humidity and dry fuels together can produce extreme fire behavior in the foothills today.
Avoid any activity that could produce a spark, including outdoor burning, welding, dragging chains and parking vehicles on dry grass. Report any new fire immediately by calling 911.

instructorNote: After you hand this over, read the forecaster's phone comment aloud: "The confidence that gusts top 45 by mid-morning is moderate to high. Timing could slip an hour either way." Watch for the EM to log the warning and move the EOC to Level 2 (EOP 5, item 1). Also watch for the co-op Operations Director to count the first criterion in section 3 as met and ask for the co-op weather station gust readings before the 06:00 decision.
